whenToUse: Volume or cumulative trend over time: traffic, pipeline value, headcount.
Stacked parts of a total over time, or a previous-period comparison.
avoidWhen: Comparing rates or many overlapping series — use Line chart.
A tiny trend in a table cell or KPI — use Sparkline.
a11y: Give the chart a title and let the Chart frame generate its text summary.
Series colours come from chart tokens; keep series distinguishable by legend labels, not colour only.
